description: Yukawa kernel analytic validation (pre-dynamics pair test)

formulas.U: U = coulombK * (qi*qj / r) * exp(-r / λ_D)  for 0 < r ≤ cutoff; else 0
formulas.F_mag: |F| = coulombK * |qi*qj| * exp(-r/λ_D) * (1/r² + 1/(λ_D*r))  for 0 < r ≤ cutoff; else 0

parity_note: Build sandbox and WSL batch runner must produce identical U and |F| at the same (qi,qj,r) under LOCKED_VALIDITY_PARAMS. Kernel is pure nm-unit; no scene scaling.
disclaimer: Classical continuum electrostatics only. Educational / hypothesis tool. Not MD, docking, coordination chemistry, or biological validation.
